name: autonom
description: Universal mobile test and debug harness for AI agents. Portable skills plus a CLI control plane for device sessions, UI trees, screenshots, logs, crashes, device state, and HTTP(S) capture and mocking across Android and the iOS Simulator — Codex, Claude, Grok, and other skill-compatible agents.

interface.shortDescription: Universal mobile test/debug harness for AI agents
interface.longDescription: Autonom gives AI coding agents a portable skill pack and JSON CLI to test and debug mobile apps on Android and the iOS Simulator: explicit target sessions, compact accessibility/UI trees, semantic taps and gestures, screenshots, recordings, logs, crash reports, deep links, permissions, app-container files, a consent-gated localhost MITM proxy for inspecting, mocking, and exporting HTTP(S) traffic, and Flow v1 — repeatable flow files with exact selectors, polling assertions, and machine-readable failure classes. Works with Codex, Claude, Grok, and other skill hosts.
defaultPrompt: Use Autonom to test, debug, profile, or validate this application with evidence-backed findings.
